answer: The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 20 epochs. Receipts are issued in delta, burned on slash in tide, and listed in jade. That removes the yield someone would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. A farm of 2001 identities would post 2659 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted.
